steps.name: apply-stage19a-runtime-trace-schema-recovery-v4
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=1ca85af7f16866ae10cf45b6457e78412245df38; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; rm -f warnings.txt; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; git fetch origin agent-control; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage19/apply_stage19a_runtime_trace_schema.py > /tmp/apply-stage19a-runtime-trace-schema.py; .venv/bin/python /tmp/apply-stage19a-runtime-trace-schema.py; .venv/bin/python -c "from pathlib import Path; p=Path('tools/ml/climate_trace.py'); s=p.read_text(); old='isinstance(value, (str, int))'; new='isinstance(value, str | int)'; assert old in s; p.write_text(s.replace(old,new,1))"; .venv/bin/python -m ruff check --fix tools/ml/climate_trace.py tests/test_climate_trace.py; .venv/bin/python -m ruff format tools/ml/climate_trace.py tests/test_climate_trace.py; git diff --check; git status --short

steps.name: focused-stage19a-runtime-trace-schema-recovery-v4
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_climate_trace.py tests/test_climate_runtime.py tests/test_climate_runtime_parity.py; .venv/bin/python -m ruff check tools/ml/climate_trace.py tests/test_climate_trace.py; .venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check tools/ml/climate_trace.py tests/test_climate_trace.py; .venv/bin/python -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; import jsonschema; s=json.loads(Path('schemas/climate-runtime-trace.v1.json').read_text()); jsonschema.Draft202012Validator.check_schema(s); assert s['properties']['features']['minItems']==44; assert s['properties']['features']['maxItems']==44; assert s['additionalProperties'] is False; assert 'simulator-hidden physical truth is intentionally excluded' in s['description']"; git diff --check

verify_steps.name: full-regression-and-publish-stage19a-recovery-v4
verify_steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git add -A; .venv/bin/pre-commit run --all-files; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -m 'not hardware'; bash scripts/check_schema.sh; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests; cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel; ctest --test-dir build/host-tests --output-on-failure; bash scripts/run_clang_tidy_host.sh; git diff --check; git add -A; git diff --cached --check; git commit -m 'Add climate runtime trace schema'; git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; printf 'PUBLISHED_HEAD=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
